name: Wacom Intuos M (ExpressKeys)
description:
Configure the four ExpressKeys in Wacom Center (Windows/macOS) or with xsetwacom (Linux) to send these keystrokes (on macOS use Cmd instead of Ctrl):
  ExpressKey 1: Ctrl+Shift+F9 = Undo
  ExpressKey 2: Ctrl+Shift+F10 = Toggle pen / eraser
  ExpressKey 3: Ctrl+Shift+F11 = Next page
  ExpressKey 4: Ctrl+Shift+F12 = Previous page
Pen buttons: set the lower pen button to "Right click" (temporary eraser while pressed) and the upper pen button to "Middle click" (pan while pressed).
The usual keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Z, PgUp, PgDown, ...) are kept. See docs/INPUT-DEVICES.md for details.
